Hi everyone 😊
I have a question for mixed couples in Israel: are there any couples here where the woman is not Jewish and has not converted, and therefore the children are not considered Jewish according to Jewish religious law?

If so, have you experienced any particular difficulties with your children? Have they ever felt excluded or made to feel “different” because they are not Jewish (school/ kindergarten…) ???

I’m specifically looking for experiences from people who are actually living this situation in Israel, because my in-laws tell me that if I don’t convert, our future children will inevitably be excluded and left out. I’d really like to know how much this reflects the reality experienced by other families.

Thank you so much for sharing your experiences ❤️
